thread:
maria_sales: Heads-up - ZenithEdge wants a 2-week Private/VPC POC. Their compliance requires L3 source IP preserved for IDS, mutual TLS preferred, and very narrow firewall rules. Also asking whether PrivateLink vs Peering affects pricing or SLAs. Need a short handoff.

derek_se: Quick answers: mTLS supported. PrivateLink is fastest but will SNAT to connector ENI (so client src IP not preserved). Peering/TGW preserves L3 source IP but needs routing+SG changes. For pricing: static egress IPs are a billable add-on; peering itself doesn't change Redwood fees but cloud egress/TGW costs may apply.

anil_netops: Fast POC path: 1) Provision PrivateLink + give static test EIPs so their firewall team can allowlist and run mTLS health checks. 2) Parallel design for peering/TGW if L3 preservation absolutely required. Peering design is ~1-2 business days plus infra ticket.

zoe_eng: Minimal firewall allowlist (confirm final EIPs with infra):
- Outbound TCP 443 to: 18.206.77.201, 18.206.77.202 (Redwood test ENIs)
- DNS UDP/TCP 53 to their resolver
- NTP UDP 123 (recommended)
- Allow ephemeral return ports 1024-65535 if using NAT
- Allow ICMP type 3 for PMTU discovery

Also note MTU: many SD-WANs use 1400, recommend testing with `ping -M do -s 1400 <peer-ip>` and enable MSS clamp if needed.

maria_sales: Compliance says X-Forwarded-For is not acceptable. They need L3 preserved. Can we still get anything to them by Monday for testing?

anil_netops: We can get PrivateLink EIPs + short-lived mTLS certs by Monday for function tests. Peering design will be parallel; if approved we can schedule route changes ASAP. Need primary firewall contact for ZenithEdge.

derek_se: Curl snippets (replace certs):
`curl --cert poc-client.crt --key poc-client.key -v https://zenith.pvtl.redwood.ai:443/healthz`
Non-mTLS: `curl -v https://zenith.pvtl.redwood.ai:443/healthz`

If moving to peering, ensure SNAT is disabled toward connector subnets so IDS sees client IPs.

infra-bot: notice: upcoming infra change freeze 2025-06-30 22:00 - 2025-07-01 04:00 UTC may delay ENI provisioning if requested in that window.

maria_sales: Action items: 1) Anil to share test EIPs + allowlist by EOD, 2) Derek to prepare short-lived mTLS certs and scripts, 3) Zoe to draft a one-line pricing delta for static egress vs reserved bundle. I'll loop in their firewall contact once we have EIPs.

anil_netops: I'll request test ENIs and EIPs now; need their firewall contact (name + email).
